title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 6.17 (versions follow prime numbers; 617 after 613): what is written wrong she reads by what it is like. Razar's spelling rule (2026-11-07) lived only in its old reader; now it is in her body, where she takes what is written to her. The rule is of her Book: which two letters follow each other inside a word, a pair being proven when two different words have it. A word she has never read that has an unproven pair is read as the word she knows one letter away (one taken out, one changed, one put in), the one her books say in most lines; repeated letters are tried squashed. A name she never read whose pairs are all proven is left as it is. What was typed stays in their talk as typed. Seen in a hidden copy. Words of four letters or more only; one letter away only. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.57: Luma purificada. Prototipo de investigación.
